defs.def: unable to think clearly or to understand what is happening or what sb is saying 糊涂的；迷惑的

ex.s: I thought my pronunciation was the problem, so I explained again more slowly, but he still looked confused.
ex.t: 我以为是我的发音有问题，于是更慢地又解释了一遍，但他还是一脸困惑。
